name: Private utility locating & concrete GPR scanning — owner-operator for renovation subcontractors and GCs, Chicago + Cook/DuPage
summary: Recurring B2B accounts. A 'customer' is an active contractor account (electrical, plumbing/mechanical, GC, coring) that books scanning/locating visits; ARPC = average monthly billing per active account. New accounts come from founder field-sales conversations (site visits, superintendent meetings) and a part-time BD hire from month 24; technicians (each with a concrete GPR + EM locator kit and vehicle) are hired by capacity (~20 visits/accounts per tech per month) after the founder's first ~15 accounts. Operating profit is before owner compensation and includes the founder's own field work.
evidence_notes: Price evidence: GSA CALC ceiling rates — LaBella 'Subsurface Utility Field Technician' $124.69/h, senior $134.66/h [B, DF-S029] (≈$1,000 per 8-h day); consumer/SEO price guides half-day $300-600, full day $800-1,500 or $1,000-3,000 [D, C3-S028]; GPRS federal awards FY22-26 median $5,800 per project (range $925-$18,609), incl. $5,800 sewer mapping at VA Danville IL [A, DF-S027].

Equipment (dealer list prices, UCG Underground Supplies): Radiodetection RD8200+TX10 $9,592; RD7200+TX5 $5,657; Vivax vLoc3-Pro+Loc3-5Tx $5,530; Radiodetection LMX100 GPR $20,508; LMX200 $36,476; ImpulseRadar PinPointR $18,444; RD8200 kit rental $599/month [B, DF-S026]. Concrete GPR (GSSI Mini XT class) $11-17k [D, C3-S024]; federal buys: ImpulseRadar $16,710 (Army 2024), Leica GPR system $31,417 (NASA 2026) [A, DF-S028].

Demand: City of Chicago issued 5,042 permits with reported cost ≥$250k from Jan 2025 to Nov 2026 (3,325 renovation/alteration) [A, DF-S030]; total issued permits fell 34% 2019-2025 [A, WS10-S010]. JULIE does not locate private lines [B, WS11-S031].

Competition: GPRS (national, Chicago crews, active acquirer) [D, DF-S032, WS13-S033]; Hard Rock Technologies (Chicago, 5 CSDA-certified GPR techs), Butler Scanning (Gurnee), Cobra Concrete Cutting (in-house GPR team) [D, DF-S031].

Labour: BLS/O*NET 2025 Surveying & Mapping Technicians, Chicago median $57,470 [C, DF-S033]; experienced GPR tech assumed $65k + 25% load (E). Productivity ~20 billable visits/tech/month ≈ $180k/yr revenue per tech, vs US NAICS 541370 ~$138k receipts per employee [C, C3-S015].
Pricing and account behaviour (ARPC, churn, win rates) are E — no Chicago rate card or contractor purchase data was found. Validation experiments must establish them.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: Buy kit, manufacturer training + NDT/CSDA-type certification (~$1,000/level [D, C3-S024]), GL/E&O certificates GCs require.
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Subs book days ahead; first job usually a trial (Stage C).
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified conversations (superintendent/PM meetings, site walks, coring-firm referrals) per month from permit-data targeting [A for target list, DF-S030].
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: First job -> repeat account (GPRS incumbency lowers it).
drivers.rep_new_customers_per_month__source: New accounts per month from a part-time business-development hire (month 24+).
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Superintendents move between firms; coring/cutting firms refer.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Accounts lapse between projects; permit volume down 34% 2019-25 [A, WS10-S010].
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: ≈1 visit per active account per month x $550-1,000 per visit (half/full-day mix). GSA CALC $124.69/h [B, DF-S029]; price guides $300-1,500/visit [D, C3-S028]; GPRS federal project median $5,800 [A, DF-S027] (multi-day).
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Direct costs other than technician time: marking paint/flags, mileage beyond base, report printing, consumables (labour is staff).
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Discounted trial scan, lunch-and-learns, travel per won account.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: Website/SEO for 'concrete scanning near me', association dues, CRM.
drivers.dso_days__source: Subcontractor/GC net-30 to net-60 (Stage A record); small jobs card-paid on site.
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Kit (concrete GPR + EM locator), later utility GPR, insurance, 6 months of fixed costs and receivables.
drivers.maint_capex_pct_op__source: GPR/locator replacement every ~5-7 years plus vehicles.
drivers.ev_multiple__source: GPRS is an active acquirer of locating firms (13 deals 2018-25) [D, WS13-S033]; multiples not disclosed.

staff.notes: Hired when active accounts exceed founder capacity (~15) and every +20 accounts. Pay: Chicago surveying/mapping tech median $57,470 [C, DF-S033]; experienced GPR tech $65k x1.25 load = $6.8k + vehicle ~$0.9k/mo (E). Capex/hire: concrete GPR ~$15k [D, C3-S024] + EM locator $5.5k [B, DF-S026] + used vehicle ~$20k + tablet/software (E).
Chicago dispatcher median $58,900 [C, DF-S033]; loaded x1.2 (E).

overhead.notes: GC-required limits MISSING; Insureon small-biz averages GL $45/mo, E&O $88/mo, commercial auto $245/mo are floors [D, DF-S034].

overhead.item: GPR processing / CAD-PDF reporting / FSM software + AI report drafting
